stumbles.quote: Lock your phone's screen rotation in portrait before you start, because the game prompts you to turn the phone to landscape itself.
stumbles.why: Confusing: if rotation is locked in portrait, it's unclear how turning to landscape works or what the game does. The reason given doesn't clearly explain why locking helps, and it seems to conflict with the later instruction to turn the phone to landscape.

stumbles.quote: Turn the phone to landscape when prompted
stumbles.why: Conflicts with the portrait rotation lock. It doesn't say how the prompt appears or how landscape is possible with the lock on.

stumbles.quote: hold it at the angle you want as neutral, because the game zeroes your tilt when the start lights go out
stumbles.why: The 'start lights' are never introduced. It's unclear when they go out or how I'd know when to hold neutral. The sentence also doesn't say what 'neutral' covers or whether I can recalibrate later.

stumbles.quote: Tilt the top of the phone away from you to accelerate, and tilt it towards you to brake.
stumbles.why: In landscape, 'the top of the phone' is ambiguous. It could mean the edge that was the top in portrait, or the top edge as held in landscape. It's also unclear which landscape direction applies.

stumbles.quote: Hold the phone in portrait on the first screen to choose your track, laps and difficulty.
stumbles.why: It doesn't say how to choose (tap, tilt?) or what the difficulty and lap options are. Tilt steering is only described later, so it's unclear whether selection uses touch or tilt.

stumbles.quote: Three tracks ship: Fjord, Quarry and Ring.
stumbles.why: 'Ship' is jargon, and the tracks are not described. This is minor, but it is a name list with no explanation.

point: To play Tilt Rally, open the page on a motion-sensor phone, allow motion access on iOS, pick a track, laps and difficulty in portrait, then turn the phone to landscape and steer by tilting it left or right, accelerate by tilting the top away from you, and brake by tilting it towards you.
